channel.provenance_note: Official Parliament Mediathek. The institutional sitting guide documents live Nationalrat, Bundesrat and Bundesversammlung coverage. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed dated sittings of both chambers. Keep one shared portal record until distinct recurring chamber or room player identities are validated.

accessibility.notes: Live caption, sign-language and audio-description availability has not been established for individual events; no absence is inferred from the player page.

permission.summary: Parliament terms allow specified political reporting, political education and private non-commercial uses. Audiovisual material must carry the Parlamentsdirektion copyright marking; attribution and third-party rights also apply. Individual ORF/live-media ownership and full-stream reuse were not established, so this record remains an official viewing link.
permission.recommendation: Open the official service for viewing. Do not extract provider manifests or enable independent playback until source-specific media stability and applicable reuse conditions are established.
